title: Reminders
intro: Workout, mewing and posture reminders on the days and times you choose. Notifications stay on your iPhone.

errors.tooMany: You can have up to {{max}} reminders. Delete one to add another.
errors.tooManyTimes: That's more notifications than an iPhone keeps for one app. Use fewer times or days.

permission.off: Notifications are off for {{app}}, so reminders can't show up.
permission.denied: Turn on notifications for {{app}} in the iPhone Settings app to get reminders.
